title: Opening, closing and duplicating in Music and Classes never acts on a stale or hidden request
acceptance: openPlaylist ignores a late reply for a playlist no longer shown and clears the songs on Back, so Start class never creates class B with A's songs (lane-B repro passes).
Duplicate runs through useAsyncAction: it shows pending state and an error message, and a repeat tap does not make a second copy (lane-B repro passes).
Closing the playlist or likes dialog during Creating does not navigate the instructor into the new class later; the recommended behavior is to skip navigation and show a toast.
TrackPreview Reconnect writes a destination:'builder' return record and catches failures; a new test covers the return record. The e2e smoke is unchanged.
nextAction: Await owner Ready; the close-during-Creating behavior is a small product call (recommended: skip navigation and toast). Files: Music playlist/likes dialogs, Classes duplicate action, TrackPreview in apps/web. Not owner-gated per scripts/owner-gate.mjs at audit time.
